purpose: Teach: 最古/三振/高地/産学/海賊版/長け/ショールーム/師団

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、業界最古参の老舗との縁を大事にされた
lines.en: Your father, back in his youth, treasured his ties with the oldest house in the industry.
lines.style: Slow, savoring opening, eyes on the middle distance. Gentle weight on the word treasured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは「営業の三振、つまり三度失敗から学べ」と仰った
lines.en: Yes. Father always said, 'Learn from a strikeout in sales — from failing three times.'
lines.style: Firm, measured quoting, voice dropping slightly to carry the old man's gravity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、ペルー高地のコーヒー農園と取引された
lines.en: When he was young, your father did business with coffee farms up in the Peruvian highlands.
lines.style: Faraway warmth, pace drifting like turning old photographs. A soft lift on the place name.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは産学、つまり産学連携の先駆者だった
lines.en: Yes. Father was a true pioneer of industry-academia collaboration.
lines.style: Controlled pride, steady and clipped. A small pause before pioneer, letting it land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海賊版に対し厳しい姿勢を貫かれた
lines.en: And your father never wavered — he held a hard line against pirated goods.
lines.style: Quiet firmness beneath the reminiscence. Slow, deliberate cadence, admiration in the low notes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは交渉に長けた人材を見抜かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father could spot the people with a real gift for negotiation.
lines.style: Reflective, softer than his usual register. A slight smile audible on the word gift.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、駅前にショールームを開かれた
lines.en: In his younger days, your father opened a showroom right in front of the station.
lines.style: Bright flicker of memory, tempo lifting briefly, then settling back into gentle stillness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは防災師団、つまり師団訓練の重要性を説かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father preached the importance of division-scale disaster training — a whole division drilling together.
lines.style: Resolved, quietly emphatic close. Even pacing, the final words placed like a vow.
